scenarios.assertion: Decision observed; shouldCompact=false; NO execution span opened; no integrity failure; not reported as unavailable.

The captured `shouldCompact` equals `capturedRequestInputTokens >= capturedRequestTriggerTokens`, and the captured trigger equals `capturedMaxInputTokens * COMPACTION_TRIGGER_RATIO` (the EXACT production constant, imported from `compaction-shared.ts`, not guessed). This is a strictly-below-threshold fixture; the former misleading `Exactly at threshold` title was renamed rather than claimed as an equality witness.
The final sanitized `compaction_decision` trace preserves `compactionMode` and `compactionStrategy` for auto, manual, and overflow-recovery decisions.
No decision payload or identity is published; the ordinal does not advance; the capture adds no API-message JSON serialization relative to the pre-existing production work.
Correct threshold captured; `shouldCompact=true`; `compactionInitiated=true`; exactly ONE execution span opened.

Captured factor equals the production calculation `min(4, max(1, actualPreviousInputTokens / requestInputTokens))`; the captured `maxInputTokens` equals `rawMaxInputTokens / underestimateFactor`; the captured trigger equals `maxInputTokens * ratio`.
Captured effective budget equals the production resolver: `rawMaxInputTokens=50000`, `userContextCeiling=50000`, `inputBudgetSource='userCeiling'`.

Auto mode invents NO default-budget decision: the production seam returns before the decision, and NO record is fabricated (not even a `NOT_EVALUATED` classification — the existing internal contract does not support one safely).
`mode='manual'`; `shouldCompact=false` AND `compactionInitiated=true` — the two facts are independent and both captured.
Three decisions (two sharing an iteration) receive THREE distinct `decisionId`s and ordinals 0/1/2 — no collision.
No successful completion is fabricated: the execution span stays OPEN and is reported as an integrity failure.
No state or request semantic delta: the armed and disarmed runs produce identical results.
Existing failure isolation preserved: the compaction still runs and still produces its result when the diagnostic sink throws.
A synthetic API key and URL in the messages are ABSENT from the exported trace.
Explicit truncation metadata: `truncation.truncated === true` and `droppedEventCount > 0`; no invented continuity.

conservation.no_second_message_builder_build: The captured `apiMessageCount` and `messageCount` are the counts of the projection the seam was HANDED — the capture never invokes the stateful production `MessageBuilder` a second time.
conservation.no_semantic_delta_when_off: The decision ordinal is allocated ONLY when the diagnostic sink is armed (`isTraceEnabled() !== false`). With diagnostics OFF no counter advances and no state is kept.

span_correctness_invariants: Every eligibility check generates at most ONE decision observation.
A false eligibility result creates NO compaction execution span.
An initiated compaction opens ONE execution span, closed by its actual completion/failure/cancellation.
No synthetic execution duration is manufactured — the decision is a POINT observation (`tracer.recordPoint`), which never calls `enter()`.
A missing terminal observation leaves the span explicitly OPEN (an integrity failure), never a fabricated success.
A point observation leaves NO 'span left open' integrity failure, because the tracer derives that failure from `openSpans`, which only `enter()` populates.
